Three children—two boys and one girl—are seated behind the table in a room with light wooden paneling. (2) The camera pans to focus on the birthday boy on the left, who is wearing a black sweatshirt with red and blue stripes on the cuffs. He bashfully covers his mouth and nose with both hands, squinting his eyes in a wide, joyful smile. To his right, a younger boy in a brown shirt claps rhythmically, while a girl in a light green sweatshirt watches the cake with a happy expression. (3) A series of close-up shots capture the birthday boy's reactions; he remains shy, burying his face in his palms while looking at the camera. The girl in the green sweatshirt leans in, her face bright under the clear indoor lighting. The environment is a typical domestic interior with household items visible in the soft-focus background. (4) The girl in the green sweatshirt raises her hand and speaks directly to the camera with an animated expression, gesturing toward her brother. The birthday boy listens, then reacts with a wide-eyed, playful look of protest or surprise. The younger boy in the middle continues to watch the interaction from behind the table. (5) The birthday boy leans forward toward the cake, takes a deep breath, and blows out the single lit candle. As he does so, stylized yellow and pink 'Happy Birthday' text overlays appear around the cake along with star graphics. The other children react with excitement and clapping in the background. (6) The final scene transitions to a wider group shot of the entire family on a grey sofa. Two adults—a man with glasses and a woman with short hair—sit at either side of the three children. They all look at the lens, smiling broadly, making peace signs with their fingers, and appearing to cheer in unison.
